title: The Pulse — September 11, 2026
tldr: OpenAI shipped two production APIs yesterday: GPT-Live-1 for full-duplex voice agents and the Agents API with managed Codex orchestration. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash switched to an encoder-decoder architecture. Cognition's SWE-2 model rivals Fable and GPT-Astra on coding benchmarks.

models.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.summary: Sparse MoE model (8B active on input, 16B on output) using a new Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture.
models.why: First encoder-decoder in the V4 line; architectural shift worth tracking when eval results land.

models.title: InclusionAI Ling 3.0 Flash VL
models.summary: 124B total / 5.5B active MoE adding native visual perception to the Ling 3.0 Flash base.
models.why: Free tier multimodal option on OpenRouter; worth testing for budget-conscious vision tasks.

research.title: Can LLMs Normalize Databases? A Benchmark and Multi-Agent Framework for Schema Normalization
research.summary: Benchmark measuring LLM ability to reason about functional dependencies and lossless join decompositions for database normalization.
research.why: Tests structured-output reliability when outputs must satisfy database constraints; relevant for schema generation work.

research.title: REVA: Reusable Evidence View Aggregation for Context-Efficient RAG Serving
research.summary: Post-retrieval compression that reuses compressed views across queries to reduce latency and KV cache cost.
research.why: Addresses the cost side of RAG serving; relevant for EverRaise and Mackinac where retrieval volume is high.

research.title: RAG-Safety-Bench: Reliable Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented LLM Safety
research.summary: Benchmark showing RAG can degrade safety when prompted for harmful content if retrieved documents introduce risk.
research.why: Safety evaluation gap for RAG systems; worth knowing before deploying user-query-driven retrieval.

research.title: Decoupling Readiness from Release for Tail-Aware Scheduling of Agentic LLM Workflows
research.summary: Agent-turn scheduling policy that delays release of ready turns to reduce tail latency under contention.
research.why: Agentic workflow optimization; applies when we run multi-turn agent jobs under load.

releases.title: LangChain Anthropic 1.7.2
releases.summary: Preserves invalid tool-use blocks instead of dropping them.
releases.why: Relevant for EverRaise and SalesKick if we're using Anthropic models through LangChain.

hackernews.title: Shopify is moving from React Native back to Swift and Kotlin
hackernews.summary: After years of React Native, Shopify is rewriting mobile apps in native code citing performance and platform integration.
hackernews.why: Signals trade-offs in cross-platform mobile stacks; relevant if client projects consider React Native.

hackernews.title: Cognition launches SWE-2 model, rivaling Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra
hackernews.summary: Cognition's new coding model claims performance on par with Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra on SWE-bench and coding evals.
hackernews.why: Another strong coding model entering production; worth benchmarking against Claude Code and Codex for PR review and feature work.

hackernews.title: OpenAI Agents API
hackernews.summary: Managed agent service with Codex harness, orchestration, long-running sessions, and context management.
hackernews.why: Competes with Claude Managed Agents; relevant for SalesKick and Pipeline's agent workloads if we want fully managed execution.

hackernews.title: Neki – Sharded Postgres
hackernews.summary: PlanetScale's new sharded Postgres offering for horizontal scaling without application rewrites.
hackernews.why: Scaling option for Postgres-backed projects when single-node limits are hit; worth watching for Pipeline clients.

x_posts.title: OpenAI: GPT-Live-1 in the API
x_posts.summary: Full-duplex voice API that listens while speaking, with custom voices and telephony support.
x_posts.why: Production voice-agent primitive; relevant for EverRaise's Vapi integration and any future voice work.

x_posts.title: OpenAI: Agents API public beta
x_posts.summary: Cloud agent orchestration with the Codex harness, handling sessions and context management.
x_posts.why: Competes with Claude Managed Agents; worth evaluating for long-running agent workflows.

x_posts.title: Nous Research: Hermes Agent subagent UI
x_posts.summary: Hermes now shows live subagent activity with manual steering and stop controls in CLI and desktop.
x_posts.why: We run Hermes Agent for Botterfly; the subagent visibility helps debug multi-agent workflows.

x_posts.title: ClaudeDevs: Desktop app pane management
x_posts.summary: Claude Code desktop app lets you pop out diffs and terminals into separate windows.
x_posts.why: Quality-of-life for Claude Code workflows; multi-screen sessions become easier to manage.

closing: Python, Node.js, DSPy, and Langfuse: no notable releases in the window. Next.js v16.4.0-canary.26 is out but skipped per the canary rule.
